title: Unconditional Density Bounds for Quadratic Norm-Form Energies via Lorentzian Spectral Weights
summary: For a real quadratic field $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{d})$, we study the norm-form energy $N = S_ζ^2 - d \cdot S_L^2$, where $S_ζ$ and $S_L$ are Lorentzian-weighted zero sums with $w(ρ) = 2/(\tfrac{1}{4} + γ^2)$. We prove three main results. (1) Spacelike spectral data: $N 1$, as a consequence of a low-lying zero dominance theorem proved via explicit zero-counting. (2) Effective density bound: at each verified truncation level $M$, $\mathrm{dens}\{N > 0\} \leq 2\|f_{S_L^{(M)}}\|_\infty \cdot (W_1(ζ)/\sqrt{d} + ε_M)$, established unconditionally via Jacobi--Anger resonance analysis.
